title: ESG Score - Maturidade Socioambiental de Fornecedores
summary: A student ML project (CESAR School) that classifies suppliers into Baixa/Media/Alta ESG maturity from a 10-record questionnaire dataset, using synthetic data plus controlled perturbation to expand the training set to 55 rows. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) is run in src/synthesize.py to generate 30 of the synthetic samples for data augmentation and class-imbalance mitigation.
